title: A quasi-compact monomorphism of algebraic spaces with injective structure sheaf pullbacks is an isomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces), section on universally injective morphisms
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma concerns a quasi-compact monomorphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces such that for every T -> Y the map O_T -> f_{T,*}O_{X x_Y T} is injective, and concludes that f is an isomorphism (statement lines 318-326). The proof turns the hypothesis into universal injectivity of the ring map A -> B of an affine etale presentation, translates quasi-coherent sheaves on X into descent data DD_{B/A}, and then uses descent to compute that f^* is exact on quasi-coherent modules (proof lines 334-352). The non-routine step is precisely that translation: the injectivity hypothesis is used on the split module A + M to produce the universal injectivity that the descent theorem needs, after which flatness and surjectivity of f and the fpqc descent of isomorphism finish the proof (proof lines 341-359). The author flags one small omission, the passage to flatness (proof line 353), so H2.
